responsibility: Declares the RTExceptions runtime interface, exporting the opaque exception-block type plus operations to raise exceptions, manage the active exception block, inspect exception text and numbers, push and pop handlers, query or switch exception state, and track exception source information. This header is the primary contract for low-level runtime exception machinery, distinct from the higher-level language exception enumeration in GM2EXCEPTION.h.
same_name_distinction: This header differs from GRTExceptions.cc by exposing only the public contract: an opaque RTExceptions_EHBlock type, procedure-handler type, and function prototypes for exception control. It does not define the internal exception-block layout, handler-stack structures, or raise/catch implementation logic found in the .cc file.
